title: From structure to function: a one-dimensional palladium(II) hybrid for real-sample hydroquinone detection
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08631K, Paper

Sarra Bougossa, Naoufel Ben Hamadi, Jassem Wannassi, Noureddine Mhadhbi, Jeanneau Erwann, Ahlem Guesmi, Lotfi Khezami, Houcine Barhoumi, Houcine Naïli
A novel 1D palladium(II)–imidazole hybrid, (C4H7N2)[PdCl3(H2O)], was synthesized and structurally characterized. It shows semiconducting behavior (Eg = 2.18 eV) and enables highly sensitive electrochemical detection of hydroquinone (LOD = 0.02 µM).
